title: Component fidelity & touch-interaction regression sweep across Safari, Firefox, and Android WebView
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background: After the runtime and CSS token updates merged in ui-kit v2.14, QA flagged a set of cross-browser regressions that affect interaction fidelity and visual alignment on WebKit and Gecko engines and within embedded Android WebViews. This ticket is a focused design QA sweep to triage, reproduce, and document fixes or workarounds for the most visible regressions impacting buttons, tables, charts, and token-driven spacing across small and large viewports.

Goal: Produce a prioritized bug list with reproduction steps, screenshots/video, severity, and recommended owner (Design, Eng, or Shared). Deliverables are: (1) a triage spreadsheet with reproducibility status, (2) annotated screenshots and short clips hosted in Drive, (3) labeled GitHub issues/PRs or follow-ups, and (4) acceptance criteria for any visual or interaction fixes.

Scope (in): Buttons (pressed/active/long-press), focus rings, token spacing on form controls, table sticky headers and row hover alignment, chart tooltips and pointer offset on transformed containers, mobile touch affordances and hit target regressions. Testing targets include desktop Safari (macOS), Safari on iOS, Firefox desktop (macOS/Windows), Firefox on Android, and Android WebView in common app containers.

Scope (out): Full redesign work, performance profiling of runtime kernels, backend API changes. Anything requiring >2 sprints of engineering is out; create follow-up ENG tickets instead.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Each reported issue must include OS/browser, viewport size, repeatable steps, and at least one visual artifact (screenshot or 10s clip).
- Issues are triaged into three buckets: fix-in-UI-kit, design workaround, platform limitation (cannot fix).
- High severity regressions (visual breakage or broken interactions) assigned owners with target PR or mitigation plan.
- QA sign-off for each fix verifying the component renders correctly on the affected browsers.

Test matrix (minimum):
- macOS Safari 16-17: 1280x800 and 1440x900
- iOS Safari (iPhone 14, iPhone 12) portrait and landscape
- Windows Firefox 115+: 1366x768
- macOS Firefox 115+: 1280x800
- Android Firefox (Pixel 5 emulator)
- Android WebView (Android 13) inside sample Shell app with default CSS resets

Key items to validate (examples documented during sweep):
1) Buttons: long-press active state disappears after 300ms on iOS Safari when transform: translateZ(0) is on the container. Repro steps and a 12s clip attached. Expected: active state persists during touch.
2) Focus rings: custom focus token offset misaligned in Firefox when zoom level != 100%. Repro steps attached. Expected: ring aligns to token inset and control border.
3) Tables: sticky header jitter on Firefox during viewport resize and with overflow:auto on container; header loses alignment with columns by 1-3px. Expected: stable sticky header alignment across resizes.
4) Charts: tooltip x-offset on Android WebView when parent has CSS transform scale(1) applied by host app; pointer events location mismatch observed. Expected: tooltip anchored to correct data point.
5) Hit targets: small secondary icon buttons under dense tokens are below 44px on some Safari breakpoints, causing missed taps. Expected: maintain minimum touch target or fallback layout.

Proposed test steps (per issue):
- Create simple reproduction page in ui-kit/examples/regression/ (link below).
- Open BrowserStack or local device lab for targeted platform.
- Record short clip and take annotated screenshot.
- Note the exact commit/tag of ui-kit used.
- Attempt simple CSS toggles (remove transform, toggle will-change, remove -webkit-overflow-scrolling) to identify mitigation. Document results.

Rollout/mitigation guidance: 
- If a CSS-only workaround fixes reliably, add a temporary design token override and file ENG follow-up to revert after kernel/runtime fix.
- For platform-limited issues (e.g., WebView host transform behavior) document recommended host app mitigations and mark as platform limitation.

Notes on priority: anything visible to customers in the Console product or onboarding templates is P1. Internal preview panels may be P2 if workaround exists.
comments: 2026-02-25 Asha Patel: Kickoff — scoped test matrix and initial examples repo created. Linked example pages in Drive and tiny sample app for Android WebView. Blocking: need access to new BrowserStack enterprise project.

2026-02-27 Marcos Rivera: Confirmed reproduce for button long-press on iOS 16 and iOS 17; added short clip to Drive and pointed to CSS transform workaround that mitigates but doesn't fully restore active animation. Assigned ENG-4478 for investigation.

2026-03-02 QA Team (Lena Cho): Found table sticky header misalignment on Firefox when header row contains inline-flex icons. Captured repro steps; creating GH issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui-kit/issues/1299
2026-03-05 Marcos Rivera: Created triage spreadsheet and prioritized 6 items. Added severity and tentative owners. Uploaded annotated screenshots: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aq-example

2026-03-09 Asha Patel: Design review with PM. Decided to ship token override for touch targets as interim fix and open ENG tickets for long-term kernel/runtime investigation. Added acceptance checklist to description.

2026-03-12 Marcos Rivera: Follow-up — ENG provided a small CSS patch PR that addresses focus ring offset in Firefox: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui-kit/pull/1345. Requesting design verification on macOS and Windows Firefox.
reproducibility_notes: Several issues reliably reproduce when container has transform or will-change set — try removing these to narrow down cause.
Android WebView repro requires embedding sample Shell app; cannot reproduce in plain mobile Chrome on some devices.
Firefox focus offset only appears when zoom != 100% or when OS-level display scaling is applied on Windows.
